$comment: The price book. DATA, not code.
The Worker emits no usage events and knows nothing about money. This file is
the only place a number lives, so a price change is a one-file edit and never a
deploy of the thing an adherent studies through.
NOTHING HERE IS PUBLISHED. Every plan is status 'proposed' or 'free-permanent'
and every entry in billingGates is met:false. docs/business-model.md explains
each gate. Numbers exist so they can be argued with, not because anyone may be
billed from them.
meteredDimensions is EMPTY ON PURPOSE. At W0/W1 every /xrpc/ route returns 503
ManabiCertPrepR1PhaseGateLocked (src/app.ts) and the Worker counts nothing. A
dimension listed here that the Worker does not actually count would be a promise
to invoice from a meter that does not exist. tests/pricing-invariants.test.ts
refuses that file rather than letting an invoice quote a number nobody measured.
forbiddenDimensions is not decoration, and it is not a values statement either.
Each entry names the constitutional gate that already removed the behaviour the
unit would pay for. The two units the cert-prep market actually sells --
pass-rate uplift and an official past-question bank -- are the first two
entries, because G15 and G16 removed both at the schema level. A price per
either would re-create exactly what those gates exist to remove.
The 'why' strings are checked, not merely written: pricing-invariants asserts
that the schema fact each one depends on is still true of the vendored lexicon.

candidateDimensions.describes: one completed certPrepSession record (domain selected -> concepts reviewed -> session closed)

forbiddenDimensions.why: G15 -- certPrepSession defines no passRate / predictedScore / estimatedPassProbability / cohortPercentile field, so there is no such quantity to sell; pricing one would require building the KPI the gate exists to remove
G16 -- questionSource is a closed enum of exactly synthetic-baien-generated and user-imported-personal-only; an official-vendor item bank is not a thing this schema can record, let alone invoice
G3 -- a price per badge or streak pays the operator to build engagement bait; tests/g3-no-addiction-ux-tokens.test.ts scans public/ for exactly those mechanics
G17 -- no external credential body partnership, so there is no ISACA / (ISC)2 / CompTIA referral relationship to take a cut of
G7 + N13 -- domainMasteryAttestation carries credentialClaimedAttested const false; this app records demonstrations and never issues a credential, so there is nothing to charge issuance for
G10 -- timerModeOptedIn defaults false and every demonstrationType is self-paced; selling timed sittings would make the timed path the product the untimed default exists to avoid

G6 -- a minor is carried as a 30-day rotating pseudonym (learnerDidOrPseudonym), so there is no stable person to count; a seat price would require building the identity surface the design deliberately does not have

billingGates.description: MANABI_CERT_PREP_R1_PHASE_GATE is no longer 'locked' in wrangler.jsonc
Council Lv6+ >=3 ratify of ADR-2605264400, which src/app.ts names in the 503 body as the condition for R1
the Worker actually counts study-session; today it emits no usage event of any kind
documented provenance that synthetic-baien-generated items reproduce no vendor item; G16 closes the enum but does not by itself prove what the generator emitted
terms of service and 特定商取引法 disclosure for the operating entity
a payment rail exists at all

plans.name: Adherent
plans.why: manabi is adherent-facing study infrastructure; a wall in front of the concept readers would price access to knowledge the charter exists to hand over

plans.name: Operator — self-host
plans.audience: 宗教法人 / study circle running the Worker themselves
plans.why: Apache-2.0 + Charter Compliance Rider; the real cost of entry is Council ratification and question provenance, neither of which is payable in money

plans.name: Operator — managed tenancy
plans.audience: operators who want the ratification honoured and the Worker run for them
plans.why: flat, with no usage component, because nothing is metered; the number prices provenance and ratification upkeep rather than compute -- static assets behind a thin dispatcher cost almost nothing to run -- and is a starting point for argument, not chargeable until every billingGate is met
